documentsListArchivedNote: Archived documents are not shown or counted. Use the eye in the header to include them.
documentsEmptyAll: Nothing has been shared with you, and you have uploaded nothing yourself.
documentsEmptyActive: Nothing active has been shared with you. There may be archived documents: use the eye in the header.
documentsDeleteBody: The file and the record of it go for good, for everybody it was shared with. To take it out of the way without destroying it, archive it instead.
documentsFormGone: That document is not in your list any more. It may have been deleted, archived, or un-shared with you.
documentsFormForbidden: Only the person who uploaded a document, or an administrator, can change it. Being able to open a document is not the same as being able to rewrite it for everybody else.
documentsFormKeepFileHint: Leave this alone to keep the current file. Files must be 25 MB or smaller.
documentsFormSizeHint: Files must be 25 MB or smaller.
documentsFormTitleHelper: Must be unique within the organisation
documentsFormActiveHint: Archiving hides a document from the default list. The file and everyone it is shared with stay exactly as they are.
documentsFormShareHint: Leave everything unticked to keep it to yourself. Administrators can open every document either way.
documentsFormTeamsHint: A team share reaches whoever is in the team at the time, not whoever is in it today.
documentsFormListsMissing: The people and teams list is not available, so sharing cannot be changed right now. Saving keeps everyone this document is shared with.
documentsFormInactiveShares: {count, plural, =1{Also shared with one person no longer active. Saving keeps that share.} other{Also shared with {count} people no longer active. Saving keeps those shares.}}
